title: Beyond Monolingual Assumptions: A Survey on Code-Switched NLP in the Era of Large Language Models across Modalities
findings: The paper identifies religious hate speech detection as an emerging research area in code-switched NLP, highlighting the 'DweshVaani' dataset for Hindi-English. It notes that methods like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., QLORA on Gemma-2) are being applied to this task. The survey also points to safety-oriented studies, such as the Qorgau framework, for evaluating safety in regional bilingual contexts like Kazakh-Russian.
